text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kuwaiti press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Egyptian ministers and businessmen to visit Kuwait on Monday to study possible joint projects worth $1.18 billion.
- Washington sends eight F-117A stealth fighters to Kuwait. Iraq's Saddam Hussein moves troops towards southern border with Kuwait.
- Supreme committee for naturalisation to review 75,000 cases of stateless people residing in Kuwait.
- U.S. President Clinton considers launching more effective strikes against Iraqi military targets.
- Oil prices climb to highest level since Gulf War as tension mounts over Saddam's moves.
